    Welcome to Evoke.

    The small business with a big family.

    Evoke is a family owned and operated renovations company serving Christchurch and it's surrounding area. We specialise in beautiful bathroom renovations, showstopping kitchens renovations and bespoke custom joinery. And our Christchurch workshop means everything is manufactured right here, in New Zealand.

    With over 30 years combined experience, as well as having all our trades in-house, your renovation couldn't be in better hands. From your initial consultation, right the way through to completion, your project is managed by our team of highly trained and qualified tradespeople who work together with one purpose: to give you an unrivalled renovation experience. 

    ​

    Husband and wife owners, Anthony and Joanne (preferably Ants and Jo), have successfully recruited their children, children's partners, grandchildren and even the family dog into creating and holding up the Evoke brand - the brand we are certain you will come to know and love. In our endeavour to achieve the greatest results for your home and space, it's vital that we become familiar with each other; you can be rest assured that you and your home will be treated with respect, commitment and care - just as we would with family.


    For over a decade, the Evoke family has come to deliver some of the finest personal service in Christchurch. Our clients are at the forefront of every decision we make when redesigning and crafting beautiful spaces in the home, and it's by our commitment to you that allows us to successfully deliver a renovation service that goes above and beyond, every time.

    Welcome to Evoke, we're glad you're here.

    We don't use subcontractors.

    All our trades are in-house.

    At Evoke, every part of your renovation is delivered by our own in-house team. Instead of relying on subcontractors, we have dedicated specialists who work together daily, ensuring clear communication, consistent workmanship, and a smoother process from start to finish.
     

    Our in-house team includes:

    • Project Managers​

    • Kitchen Designers

    • Joiners

    • Builders

    • Electricians

    • Plumbers

    • Painters

    • Plasterers

    • Tilers
       

    By keeping everything under one roof, decisions are made quickly, delays are minimised, and your renovation receives the care, accountability, and personal attention it deserves throughout the entire project.
